patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact visual sections that take over the viewport, creating distinct visual chapters as the user scrolls.
Extremely large, blocky, uppercase sans-serif typography for headings, creating a strong, almost architectural visual presence.
A vibrant, high-contrast neon palette (greens, yellows, pinks, blues, oranges) used as accents against a dominant black background.

Dramatic scroll-triggered content transitions where entire visual themes and backgrounds are replaced or revealed sequentially, rather than elements simply animating into view. A sticky navigation bar appears after the initial hero scrolls past.
Each section functions as a distinct, full-screen visual statement, often featuring elaborate, psychedelic illustrations or bold typographic treatments.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-driven content layering and replacement system. As the user scrolls, full-screen visual sections are sequentially revealed or swapped out, creating a dynamic, almost cinematic narrative flow.
A persistent navigation bar is introduced and made sticky to the top of the viewport once the initial hero content has scrolled past, providing continuous access to key links.
Visuals are characterized by full-bleed, often psychedelic illustrations and extremely large, heavy display typography, set against dark backgrounds to maximize contrast and impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy, blocky sans-serif headings (~5-10x body text) for maximum impact, contrasted with small, legible sans-serif for navigation and details.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most content blocks and typography, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like navigation buttons and specific graphic elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with large negative space around dominant visual elements and text blocks, contributing to the high-impact, art-gallery feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its audacious, full-page scroll-triggered visual transformation, where each scroll depth unveils a completely new, high-contrast, and often psychedelic art piece or typographic statement, making the browsing experience feel like an interactive art installation rather than a traditional website.
